name: Five chair rises
rangeNote: A fitness test, so there is no lab range: your result is compared with people of your age and sex in published norm tables (shown on this page).
summary: How many seconds it takes to stand up from a chair five times as fast as you safely can, without using your arms. It reflects leg strength and how easily you get up from a seat. A shorter time is better.

high.meaning: A slower time (higher number) for your age means less leg strength and power. More than 15 s is a sign of possible muscle loss in older people (EWGSOP2).

low.meaning: A faster time (lower number) for your age means stronger legs.
